## Summary

**P19.3 — Capstone composed verification (CAPSTONE step 3).** Drives the whole SIG build as **one
unit** for the first time: PG18+PostGIS claim spine (real `db/sqitch.plan`) → OCFL evidence store →
connector replay over committed fixtures → entity resolution → the reconciliation resolver → the
read API → exports → the `web/` build — committed as a Docker-gated composed test — plus the
retroactive `implement-spec` Phase-5.3 live verification the 28 fixture-only / not-recorded tickets
skipped. The output tells P19.4 exactly which seams are CODE gaps.

**Tests + tool scripts only — no production code.** The spine wiring (PG `ClaimSink`, DB-backed
`ReadStore`, ER persistence, web-reads-exports) is P19.4 / P19.5 / P21.4; this ticket owns
`tests/e2e/` and the **xfail-by-LD-id** convention.

Stacked on `devin/p19-2-capstone-gap-analysis`. Implements
`docs/tickets/P19.3__capstone-composed-verification.md`.

## What changed

- **`tests/e2e/test_composed_stack.py`** — ordered **S1–S8**, one seam per test, sharing session
  fixtures. Module skips without Docker; with `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1` a missing daemon is a hard
  failure (`_require_or_skip`, imported from `tests/db/conftest.py`, not re-invented). Unwired seams
  are `xfail`s whose reason begins with their `LEDGER_DEFERRALS` id — **never** a loosened assertion.
- **`tests/e2e/conftest.py`** — reuses the exact claim-spine testcontainers + sqitch harness.
- **`tests/e2e/test_isolation_reproof.py`** — LD-X06 network-isolation re-proof (DNS from inside a
  connector run still fails the run).
- **`docs/build/tools/retro_cli_matrix.sh`** — committed retro 5.3 CLI matrix (LD-V02; 17 rows).
- **`docs/build/COMPOSED_E2E_REPORT.md`** — environment, S1–S8 seam table (8 rows), 28-row retro 5.3
  table (18 fixture-only + 10 not-recorded), CLI matrix output, CODE-gap handoff, timings.
- **`docs/risk_register.md`** (`RISK-P19-05/06`) + **`docs/traceability.md`** ("Composed
  end-to-end").

## Design decisions

- **xfail, never loosen (orchestrate-build §3.1).** `pytest.xfail(reason)` where the reason begins
  with the seam's `LD` id (`^LD-[A-Z]+[0-9]+[a-z]?:`) — the crossed half of each seam is fully
  asserted; only the unwired half is deferred, visibly.
- **Real composed stack, not a fixture stand-in.** S1 stands up a real `postgis/postgis:18-3.6`
  container and deploys the real `db/sqitch.plan`; S6 serves a real uvicorn hit with real `httpx`;
  S7 runs the real `sig-exports` subprocess; S8 runs the real `npm run build`.
- **Fixtures only (Part VIII §0.7).** All connectors stay on committed fixtures
  (`ingestion_permitted=false`); live fetch is P21.3. No plate/person data; officer-naming gate
  untouched. Append-only (P1–P3) asserted through the composed DB path.

## Verification

- `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/e2e -ra` → **`10 passed, 4 xfailed`** — 0 failed, 0
  skipped; every xfail reason matches `^LD-[A-Z]+[0-9]+[a-z]?:`.
- No-Docker: `DOCKER_HOST=tcp://127.0.0.1:1 uv run pytest tests/e2e` → composed module **skips
  cleanly** (isolation re-proof still runs, 6 passed).
- `sh docs/build/tools/retro_cli_matrix.sh` → exits 0, **17 rows**.
- `make test-db` → **114 passed**. P04.1 isolation set (`pytest tests/connectors -k isolation`) → 4
  passed.
- `make check` → **`2378 passed, 4 xfailed`** (baseline 2365 + 17 new: 8 composed + 6 isolation + 3
  SPDX-header params); `verify-gen` clean.

> **CI note:** this PR's CI runs on `ubuntu-latest` with Docker present, so `tests/e2e` executes for
> real there — confirm in the CI log.
